sections.kicker: Prepared for Tierra de Frutos by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Tierra de Frutos has a farm, a fermentation and green apples. The bio says cafecito bien rico.
sections.keep: Your opening tiles of green apples and red coffee cherries. They tie the name to the taste.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.

pins.what: The bio says tasty, which every café says.
pins.why: Nothing here says why a Tierra de Frutos cup is different from another café in Medellín.
pins.how: Say the fermentation or the farm in the first line.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The bio could belong to any coffee seller in town.

pins.quote: Cafecito especial para los fans de lo buenooo
pins.what: The caption for a limited coffee never says what makes it special.
pins.why: The bag says double fermentation, and the caption does not explain it.
pins.how: Say in one sentence what the process does to the cup.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: The strongest product idea stays on the bag.

pins.quote: Todo este esfuerzo de manos amigas campesinas
pins.what: Farmer hands are mentioned and never shown.
pins.why: The grid shows leaves, fruit and bags, with no people from El Retiro.
pins.how: Show the hands and faces that grow the coffee.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: The human origin is the one story a big roaster cannot tell.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Tierra de Frutos. I spent some time on your Instagram. Three things stood out.
